headline: ATL @ LAD matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is ATL 3.82 at LAD 4.18, with a projected total of 8.00. Movement read: Both offenses moved down (ATL -0.32, LAD -0.23), so the movement points more toward run suppression than a clearer side. The projected total fell -0.55, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +15.8%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Justin Wrobleski has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 0.4 ER over the last 5 starts. Batter research is strongest for Andy Pages, Ozzie Albies, Matt Olson, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Miguel Rojas because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
